title: Some Will Depart from the Faith, A Good Servant of Christ Jesus

questions.question: Now the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will depart from the faith by devoting themselves to ____ and teachings of demons,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 (ESV): "Now the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will depart from the faith by devoting themselves to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,"

questions.question: through the insincerity of liars whose consciences are ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:2 (ESV): "through the insincerity of liars whose consciences are seared,"

questions.question: These liars forbid ____ and require abstinence from foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 (ESV): "who forbid marriage and require abstinence from foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth."

questions.question: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:4 (ESV): "For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,"

questions.question: for it is made holy by the word of God and ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:5 (ESV): "for it is made holy by the word of God and prayer."

questions.question: If you put these things before the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being trained in the words of the faith and of the good ____ that you have followed.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:6 (ESV): "If you put these things before the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being trained in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine that you have followed."

questions.question: Have nothing to do with irreverent, silly ____. Rather train yourself for godliness.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:7 (ESV): "Have nothing to do with irreverent, silly myths. Rather train yourself for godliness;"

questions.question: For while bodily training is of some value, ____ is of value in every way, as it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:8 (ESV): "for while bodily training is of some value, godliness is of value in every way, as it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come."

questions.question: We toil and strive because we have our hope set on the ____ God, who is the Savior of all people.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:10 (ESV): "For to this end we toil and strive, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe."

questions.question: Let no one despise you for your ____, but set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12 (ESV): "Let no one despise you for your youth, but set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity."

questions.question: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, to ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:13 (ESV): "Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, to teaching."

questions.question: Do not neglect the ____ you have, which was given you by prophecy when the council of elders laid their hands on you.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:14 (ESV): "Do not neglect the gift you have, which was given you by prophecy when the council of elders laid their hands on you."

questions.question: Practice these things, immerse yourself in them, so that all may see your ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:15 (ESV): "Practice these things, immerse yourself in them, so that all may see your progress."

questions.question: Keep a close watch on yourself and on the ____. Persist in this.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:16 (ESV): "Keep a close watch on yourself and on the teaching. Persist in this,"

questions.question: By persisting in this, you will save both yourself and your ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:16 (ESV): "for by so doing you will save both yourself and your hearers."

key_verse_text: Let no one despise you for your youth, but set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
